jobs.title: Senior FDA Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior FDA Compliance Analyst**

**Reports to: Head of Third Party Services**

**Position Summary**

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

**Core Responsibilities**

**FDA Regulatory Compliance**

* Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
* Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

**Program Development & Standardization**

* Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
* Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
* Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
* Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
* Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

**Auditing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
* Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
* Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
* Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

**FDA Inspection Readiness**

* Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
* Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
* Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

**Education & Training**

* Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
* Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
* Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
* Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

**Integration & New Practice Support**

* Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.

* Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
* Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
* Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
* Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
* Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
* Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
* Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
* Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

**Preferred**

* Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
* Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
* Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
* Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

***Everleap Fertility offers a comprehensive benefits package to all employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week.***

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Options
* Retirement 401K Plan
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
* Company Paid: Life Insurance &Long-Term Disability & AD&D
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition Reimbursement

**Everleap Fertility:**

Built on the legacy of RMA, Boston IVF, Conceptions, and six other leading North American fertility practices, Everleap Fertility brings together more than 200 physicians and embryologists across 60+ locations in the U.S., including 25 IVF laboratories focused on the next leap forward in reproductive medicine. We bring together commercial innovation and defense‑grade security to ensure our warfighters and allies maintain a decisive technological advantage.

* Support audits of financial information by internal and external auditors

jobs.title: Encore Financial Reporting Controllership Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**Encore Financial Reporting Controllership - Senior Consultant - Strategy, Growth, and Transformation**  
  
**Help finance organizations modernize core processes, improve transparency, and drive better business decisions. As part of Deloitte's Finance Transformation practice, you will work with finance leaders to address record-to-report and controllership challenges through practical, technology-enabled solutions. Join a team that helps clients strengthen finance operations and deliver measurable value.**  
  
**The Deloitte Encore Program is designed to enable professionals who have left the workforce to return to work with confidence. This program offers an opportunity to improve your skills in a client service environment coupled with mentorship to help support professional growth. The Encore program is an excellent opportunity to reignite your professional career.**  
  
**Recruiting for this role ends on 01/14/2027.**  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
**As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth & Transformation on the Finance Transformation Record to Report team, you will be responsible for...**  

* **Assessing current-state controllership processes, identifying gaps, and defining target-state opportunities**
* **Developing transformation roadmaps and solution hypotheses across people, process, technology, and governance**
* **Applying accounting, regulatory, and compliance requirements to finance transformation initiatives**
* **Designing improvements across finance data, cost transparency, financial close and consolidation, and reporting processes**
* **Managing day-to-day client delivery, supporting engagement planning, and contributing to proposals and recruiting efforts**

  
**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **Effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **Ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **Ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **Ability to meet deadlines**
* **Ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**The team**  
  
**Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to align with the evolving business objectives of organizations. We collaborate with CFOs, CAOs, controllers, and treasurers to develop an efficient, high-quality, data-driven, and tech-enabled controllership and treasury function. This empowers our clients to deliver greater value to their business partners and investors.**  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* **4+ years of experience in accounting, finance transformation, financial planning and analysis, or cost accounting**
* **Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Risk Management, or Economics**
* **One or more of the following: Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Cost Accountant (CCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM), or progress toward one of these credentials**
* **Experience with automation tools, including Alteryx workflows or Microsoft 365 Copilot**
* **Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.**

  
**Preferred:**  

* **Master's degree in Business, Information Systems, or Accounting**
* **Experience with internal controls or Sarbanes-Oxley compliance**
* **Experience using or administering enterprise resource planning (ERP) finance and reporting platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Workday, or JD Edwards**
* **Experience with process mapping, gap analysis, requirements definition, financial modeling, or value mapping**

  
**The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.**  
  
**You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

jobs.title: Financial Analyst II, Production Finance
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
The Production Finance team is responsible for overseeing the financial execution of our manufacturing organization. We are the intersection between engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance as it relates to production; we leverage data and business relationships to drive towards the best financial outcome for Anduril. You get to partner with Anduril's functional and business leaders by providing key insights on demand signals, production attainment, resource allocation, and Product profitability.  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst with 2-4 years of experience to join our Production Finance team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial modeling, experience in manufacturing or operations environments, and can build firm business relations with internal customers. This individual will directly own financials as well as budget control for a given product portfolio, guiding strategic decision-making, and optimizing financial performance. The successful candidate will play an active role in shaping strategy rather than functioning solely as a service provider – the deeper you go the better your results.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* End-to-end financial management of production execution: including, but not limited to, headcount, cash/working capital, demand planning, standard costing, production attainment, inventory analysis, and managing product margins.
* Establish transparency into unit economics and material cost for existing and future Anduril products.
* Work cross-functionally with Production, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Quality, and Division Finance teams to own costing models, business case analyses, and decision-making frameworks.
* Perform in-depth quantitative analyses including variance analysis (actuals vs. plan), trend analysis, scenario modeling, and root-cause investigations to identify performance drivers and risks.
* Develop complex financial models to assess various financial scenarios and support strategic initiatives.
* Identify and implement process improvements to streamline FP&A activities and enhance reporting accuracy.
* Support the development of leadership reporting and present financial insights to senior management.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA/ technical background (Manufacturing/ Supply Chain/ Operations/ Service) is a plus.
* You have 2-4 years of experience in manufacturing finance, operations finance, business unit finance, cost accounting, investment banking, or similar.
* You have a strong understanding of financial and accounting concepts.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information in an understandable manner.
* You have strong analytical aptitude and take ownership. You intuitively think about problems in terms of numbers.
  + You are able to quickly execute analyses in Excel & translate findings to business partners
  + You are comfortable using corporate systems (e.g. Oracle, Salesforce) and analytic / dashboarding tools (e.g. Palantir Foundry)
* You are comfortable communicating broadly and having a lot of eyes on your work. This role can at-times require comms to large groups and senior leadership.
* You enjoy working at a place where no one minds if you leave early one day to go to an appointment or run an errand, but you also don't mind responding to Slacks in the evening while you're watching Netflix.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. jobs.title: Senior FDA Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior FDA Compliance Analyst**

**Reports to: Head of Third Party Services**

**Position Summary**

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

**Core Responsibilities**

**FDA Regulatory Compliance**

* Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
* Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

**Program Development & Standardization**

* Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
* Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
* Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
* Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
* Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

**Auditing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
* Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
* Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
* Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

**FDA Inspection Readiness**

* Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
* Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
* Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

**Education & Training**

* Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
* Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
* Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
* Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

**Integration & New Practice Support**

* Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.

* Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
* Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
* Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
* Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
* Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
* Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
* Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
* Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

**Preferred**

* Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
* Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
* Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
* Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

***Everleap Fertility offers a comprehensive benefits package to all employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week.***

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Options
* Retirement 401K Plan
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
* Company Paid: Life Insurance &Long-Term Disability & AD&D
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition Reimbursement

**Everleap Fertility:**

Built on the legacy of RMA, Boston IVF, Conceptions, and six other leading North American fertility practices, Everleap Fertility brings together more than 200 physicians and embryologists across 60+ locations in the U.S., including 25 IVF laboratories focused on the next leap forward in reproductive medicine. Togeth

jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Financial Analyst, you’ll turn financial and operational data into clear insights that support sound business decisions. You’ll contribute to budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and strategic planning while helping teams understand performance, risks, and opportunities.

Your impact: By delivering accurate analysis and timely reporting, you’ll help business leaders make informed decisions about costs, pricing, sales, and investment.

**Duties**

* Prepare and interpret financial statements, profit and loss reports, and regulatory reporting; support financial report writing and financial report interpretation.
* Build and maintain financial projection models and other financial models for forecasting, financial planning, and corporate finance analysis.
* Perform variance analysis reporting, account analysis, Excel data analysis, and quantitative analysis to explain results and identify trends.
* Support budgeting, cost accounting, financial forecasting analysis, pricing, and financial sales analysis.
* Use accounting systems, financial reporting software, business intelligence tools, and other financial software to organize data and communicate findings.

**Requirements**

* Experience or demonstrated capability in finance, accounting, financial analysis, financial accounting, corporate accounting, or public accounting.
* Knowledge of financial concepts, financial management, financial acumen, and financial statement preparation and interpretation.
* Familiarity with applicable reporting standards and controls, including Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), as relevant to the role.
* Strong data analysis skills, organizational skills, and proficiency in Excel data analysis; able to explain findings clearly.
* Experience with technical accounting, corporate finance, investment analysis, or financial model development is preferred.

Pay: $74,600.00 - $89,900.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

**About FIT Consulting**

FIT Consulting specializes in municipal finance, asset management, and long-term infrastructure planning. We help local governments make informed decisions by transforming complex financial and asset data into clear, actionable insights.

Our team works with municipalities across British Columbia, providing expertise in asset management, financial planning, financial reporting, policy development, and organizational strategy. Through our work, we help communities develop sustainable solutions that support future generations.

As a growing consulting firm, we offer meaningful work, professional growth opportunities, and the chance to make a lasting impact on communities through sustainable financial and infrastructure planning.

**Position Summary**

FIT Consulting is seeking a motivated and analytical Financial Analyst to join our team. This fully remote position is ideal for an individual who enjoys working with data, financial analysis, and long-term planning while contributing to projects that support local governments and the communities they serve.

Working closely with senior consultants and municipal clients, you will assist in analyzing financial and asset management information, developing long-range financial forecasts, preparing reports and presentations, and supporting infrastructure planning initiatives. The successful candidate will have strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and a desire to learn and develop expertise in municipal finance and asset management consulting. Training and mentorship will be provided to support your growth and success in the role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze financial, asset management, and infrastructure-related data.
* Assist in developing financial models, forecasts, and long-term capital planning analyses.
* Support the preparation of asset management plans and sustainable funding strategies.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and supporting documentation for clients.
* Support municipal clients with full cycle accounting needs.
* Support municipal clients with Enterprise Resource Planning and/or accounting software implementation.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of financial information and data.
* Collect, validate, and analyze data from various sources.
* Assist with forecasting, financial reporting, and project-based analysis.
* Make recommendations based on findings and analysis.
* Contribute to process improvements and consulting best practices.
* Collaborate with clients and team members to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned which may include general marketing, administrative, and bookkeeping.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* CPA designation or progress toward a CPA designation is considered an asset.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in accounting, finance, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of education, training and relevant work experience will be considered.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Experience working with local governments, public sector organizations, asset management, or infrastructure planning is considered an asset but is not required.
* A willingness to learn and develop specialized expertise in municipal finance and asset management consulting.
* Experience using Microsoft PowerBi, geographical interface software, or accounting ERP software would be considered an asset.

**What We Offer**

* Fully remote, work-from-home position.
* Competitive salary of $65,000-$75,000 per year, depending on qualifications and experience.
* Training and mentorship to help you build expertise in municipal finance and asset management.
* Opportunity to work on meaningful projects that support communities throughout British Columbia
* Exposure to a variety of clients and projects in a growing consulting practice.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.

**How to Apply**

If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your financial analysis career, work remotely, and contribute to projects that help communities make informed infrastructure and financial decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your qualifications and interest in the position to:

Chris Paine  
chris@flgc.ca

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Who We Are**

CostQuest Associates is a broadband consulting firm offering a variety of specialized consulting services, GIS data, and application products. Our team utilizes GIS (Geographic Information System) solutions to design, develop, and implement economic models, applications, and geographic data to support the broadband telecommunications ecosystem.

  

We are a small company with a large profile, in constant pursuit of new challenges to expand our competencies. Our customers range from Fortune 100 companies, such as AT&T and Comcast, to government departments at the Federal and State levels. While we are proud of our accomplishments, we define ourselves by the courage to always do what’s right and the resolve to leave no stone unturned.

CostQuest Associates is based in Cincinnati, Ohio, with an office in Seattle, Washington, a presence in Washington, D.C., and a network of experts across the US.

  

**Who We Are**

CostQuest Associates services government clients and the broadband industry with services related to valuation, appraisal, public policy, engineering cost, and business planning. We excel in custom broadband telecommunication economics work and the creation of niche datasets and applications that enable companies and regulators to make effective, informed decisions, and allocate their capital more efficiently.

  

Clients such as the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and the US Department of Commerce have relied on our expertise to inform policy and regulatory decisions. In addition, our valuation and appraisal services support the tax and merger and acquisition initiatives for large services providers and other providers of broadband services.

CostQuest Associates is seeking a Senior Analyst to support consulting engagements involving broadband and telecommunications, federal and state programs, public policy, data analysis, and program implementation.

Senior Analysts take ownership of significant portions of project work, conduct and oversee complex analysis, develop client deliverables, and work directly with government and private-sector clients. * Monitor market developments to assess potential impacts on clients and programs.

* Contribute to proposals, scopes of work, and business development efforts

**Qualifications**

* 4 to 6 years of relevant professional experience

* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills and experience working with complex data, regulations, policies, or program requirements.

* Ability to interpret complex technical, regulatory, financial, and policy information and develop clear, defensible conclusions and recommendations.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and collaborate with consultants, economists, data analysts, GIS professionals, technology teams, government officials, and industry stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior FDA Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior FDA Compliance Analyst**

**Reports to: Head of Third Party Services**

**Position Summary**

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

**Core Responsibilities**

**FDA Regulatory Compliance**

* Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
* Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

**Program Development & Standardization**

* Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
* Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
* Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
* Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
* Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

**Auditing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
* Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
* Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
* Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

**FDA Inspection Readiness**

* Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
* Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
* Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

**Education & Training**

* Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
* Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
* Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
* Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

**Integration & New Practice Support**

* Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.

* Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
* Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
* Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
* Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
* Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
* Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
* Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
* Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

**Preferred**

* Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
* Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
* Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
* Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

**About the Job:** The Buyer is responsible for managing the end-to-end retail merchandising process, including product selection, vendor negotiations, and inventory planning. This role plays a key part in executing the company’s buying strategy by ensuring that product assortments meet customer demand and align with brand and financial objectives. They may also lead and mentor junior-level buyers, providing guidance and support in daily operations and development.

  

**A day in the life, what you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the product selection process for a specific category or even a broad range of categories. They develop buying strategies that align with the company’s business goals and customer preferences.

* Control the buying budget, ensuring that purchases align with financial targets.
* Monitor the profitability of the products selected and make adjustments to the assortment as needed.
* Forecast demand for products, adjust inventory levels based on sales trends, and manage stock to avoid overstocking or stockouts.
* Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, and consumer behavior to make informed decisions about the product mix.
* Stay ahead of trends and make strategic decisions based on data and intuition.
* Work closely with other departments, including marketing, finance, and supply chain teams, to ensure that their purchasing strategies are well integrated across the company.

  

**What it takes to Join:**

* 3–5 years experience in retail merchandising, with a deep understanding of market trends, product categories, and customer behavior.
* Strong negotiation skills, financial acumen, strategic thinking, and leadership abilities.
* Must be able to make decisions that balance both customer demand and profitability.

jobs.title: Bookstore Manager / Lead Buyer
jobs.description:
**Help build a new neighborhood bookstore**
-------------------------------------------

Way Station Books is a new independent bookstore from the people behind Revenge Of Comics and Pinball. We're looking for an experienced bookseller and buyer to help build a thoughtfully curated collection, connect with our neighborhood's readers, and create a bookstore people genuinely want to spend time in.

We're starting with a smaller, carefully selected inventory and plan to grow based on customer interests, sales trends, and our community. Our goal is to offer a broad selection of books with an emphasis on thoughtful discovery, great recommendations, and titles that reflect our customers' interests.

As our **Bookstore Manager / Lead Buyer**, you'll shape our collection while overseeing daily operations, leading a small team, and helping develop our online bookstore through Revenge Of's established e-commerce platform.

You'll work directly with ownership on purchasing budgets, store direction, and growth, with the independence to make day-to-day buying and operational decisions.

**This is a hands-on position for someone who understands the business of bookselling and is equally comfortable reviewing publisher catalogs, managing inventory, leading staff, and working the sales floor.**

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Book buying and inventory**

* Manage weekly purchasing of new releases, backlist titles, and replenishment inventory within agreed budgets.
* Curate a diverse collection balancing bestsellers, independent publishers, local authors, established favorites, and unexpected discoveries.
* Maintain and develop relationships with publishers, distributors, and sales representatives.
* Monitor sales trends, sell-through, inventory turnover, and vendor returns to make informed purchasing decisions.
* Oversee receiving, stock accuracy, merchandising, and inventory management.

**Store operations and team management**

* Oversee daily operations, customer service, opening and closing, register activity, and store presentation.
* Lead, schedule, and train approximately 3–4 part-time booksellers as the business grows.
* Adapt existing Revenge Of operating procedures and training materials for the bookstore.
* Create an inviting environment through thoughtful displays, knowledgeable recommendations, and excellent customer service.
* Review sales and purchasing reports, manage operational records, and provide ownership with regular updates.

**Online sales and community engagement**

* Help grow online book sales through Revenge Of's Shopify e-commerce platform.
* Maintain online listings, inventory availability, preorders, and fulfillment operations.
* Develop author appearances, book signings, release events, book clubs, and other literary programming.
* Build relationships with local authors, publishers, and community organizations.
* Collaborate with the Revenge Of team on marketing and social media, helping guide book and event promotions.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Professional bookstore experience with direct responsibility for book buying, purchasing, or inventory selection is required.
* Retail management or supervisory experience, preferably in an independent bookstore.
* Strong knowledge of books and the publishing industry, including new releases, publishers, distributors, and ordering practices.
* Experience with purchasing budgets, inventory management, replenishment, sell-through, and vendor returns.
* A genuine enthusiasm for books and the curiosity to curate beyond your own reading preferences.
* Excellent customer service, communication, organization, and leadership skills.
* Confidence using sales and inventory reports to guide purchasing decisions.
* Experience with Shopify, Shopify POS, or comparable retail and e-commerce systems, with a willingness to learn our platforms.
* A hands-on approach to everything from shelving and packing orders to assisting customers and preparing events.

**Especially helpful:** Established publisher or distributor relationships, experience opening or developing a bookstore, author-event coordination, familiarity with the Los Angeles literary community, and experience growing online book sales.

**Compensation, schedule, and benefits**
----------------------------------------

**Pay:** $32–$36 per hour, depending on experience.

**Position:** Full-time, hourly, nonexempt, and overtime-eligible.

**Schedule:** Approximately 40 paid hours per week. Initial store hours are expected to be 11 AM–7 PM, five to six days per week, with plans to expand. Scheduling will include store coverage, buying and administrative work, and occasional evening or weekend events.

**Benefits and perks:**

* Employer-funded ICHRA health reimbursement benefit for eligible full-time employees, subject to plan terms.
* One week of paid vacation annually, accrued according to company policy.
* Paid designated holidays when not worked, subject to company policy.
* Paid sick leave in accordance with California and Los Angeles requirements.
* Employee merchandise discounts at Way Station Books and Revenge Of.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Way Station Books becomes a welcoming, well-run neighborhood bookstore with a thoughtfully curated collection that grows with its customers.

Inventory is purchased strategically, operations run smoothly, and customers receive knowledgeable, friendly service. The team is organized, events are thoughtfully planned, and online sales grow alongside the physical store.

Ownership can rely on you to make informed purchasing decisions, manage daily operations, communicate clearly, and help shape the future of Way Station Books.

**How to apply**
----------------

Apply here or send your resume and a brief introduction to **jobs@revengeof.com** with the subject **"Bookstore Manager / Lead Buyer."**

jobs.title: Senior FDA Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior FDA Compliance Analyst**

**Reports to: Head of Third Party Services**

**Position Summary**

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

**Core Responsibilities**

**FDA Regulatory Compliance**

* Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
* Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

**Program Development & Standardization**

* Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
* Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
* Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
* Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
* Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

**Auditing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
* Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
* Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
* Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

**FDA Inspection Readiness**

* Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
* Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
* Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

**Education & Training**

* Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
* Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
* Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
* Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

**Integration & New Practice Support**

* Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.

* Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
* Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
* Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
* Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
* Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
* Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
* Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
* Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

**Preferred**

* Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
* Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
* Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
* Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

You won’t find a store and team like this anywhere else! We're passionate about our mission to delight customers with a unique, ever-changing marketplace of products from around the world. Our assortment is curated with stylish home décor, quality furniture, thoughtful gifts, time-honored handicrafts, and international food and beverage favorites. From handpicked finds to heartfelt teamwork, World Market is where uniqueness isn’t just celebrated—it’s what sets us apart.
  
  
Our team means the world to us! We value authenticity, empowerment and respect and we take pride in what we do. If you’re looking for a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your contributions are valued, growth is supported and you can have a little fun—you’ve found it!

**When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:**

* Benefits that support health, financial security, and personal life needs. Learn more about benefits and eligibility for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance, and more!
* Paid vacation and paid sick time

**What You’ll Do**

World Market is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Analyst to meet the purchasing needs of our 250 stores and contribute to our continued growth as we open new locations across the country. In this role, you’ll coordinate the purchasing of essential store supplies, forecast inventory levels and support the day-to-day activities that keep our stores running smoothly. You’ll also assist with procurement planning and coordination for new store openings, working closely with store operations, corporate teams, and vendors to ensure supplies are ordered and delivered on schedule.

From maintaining accurate purchasing records to tracking orders, reviewing pricing, and identifying opportunities for cost savings, your work will help support efficient store operations and the spirited shopping experience World Market is known for. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment. You’ll work collaboratively with internal teams and suppliers to coordinate purchasing activities, resolve routine order issues, maintain accurate documentation, and help ensure our stores have the supplies they need. Join us as we expand our footprint and bring our eclectic marketplace to even more communities!

* Coordinate purchasing activities for existing stores and new store openings.

jobs.title: Homelessness Prevention Management Analyst, Center on Homelessness - Limited Term
jobs.description:
The Human Services Agency (HSA) of the County of San Mateo is seeking qualified candidates to fill a term **Management Analyst** position in its Center on Homelessness (COH) branch. The Center on Homelessness contracts with community-based organizations to provide a range of services to unhoused County residents, from outreach and engagement, to shelter and case management, and matching to various housing resources. COH provides system oversight, coordination, and planning for the system of care, and manages local, state, and federal grant programs supporting these services.

This Management Analyst will serve as the program lead for a three-year, $9 million program piloting targeted homelessness prevention services funded by Right at Home (www.rightathomeusa.org) and other philanthropic support. The program will be one of ten similar programs piloted nationwide. It will strive to identify the County residents at greatest risk of becoming homeless, provide interventions to prevent them from becoming homeless, and be structured as a randomized control trial in order to identify effective strategies.

The Management Analyst will work closely with contracted service providers, program stakeholders and the funders to implement the pilot program. This will involve

* Monitoring contracts and provider performance for compliance with program and funder requirements.
* Engaging participants and people with lived experience of homelessness and housing insecurity as partners in shaping and refining program design.
* Refining program guidelines while maintaining fidelity to the program’s purpose and plan and coordinating solutions to implementation issues with the Network Coordinator/Fiscal Agent.
* Ensuring continued compliance with randomized control trial requirements.
* Reporting to funders and evaluation partners.
* Participating in the nationwide learning community with project partners.

This recruitment may be utilized to fill other Limited Term Management Analyst positions within the Center on Homelessness.

**Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that a qualified employee can perform the essential functions of the job.**
  
  
Management Analysts develop and implement policies and procedures for a variety of projects and programs, including budget, contract, and human resources administration, management analysis, and program evaluation. Incumbents support the work of departmental management staff by conducting day-to-day administrative support activities and by providing a professional-level resource for organizational, fiscal, human resources, managerial, and operational analyses and studies. The work has technical and programmatic aspects requiring the interpretation and application of policies, procedures, and regulations. Positions at this level receive only occasional instruction or assistance as new or unusual situations arise and are fully aware of the operating procedures and policies of the work unit.

* Assists in developing goals, objectives, policies, procedures, work standards, and administrative control systems for the department to which assigned.
* Develops and standardizes procedures and methods to improve and continuously monitor the efficiency and effectiveness of operations and service delivery methods and procedures in order to maximize funding and minimize costs; assesses and monitors workload and administrative and support systems; identifies opportunities for improvement and develops related recommendations.
* Plans, oversees, and administers department-specific programs and projects.
* Conducts a variety of analytical and operational studies regarding departmental and programmatic activities, including complex operational, regulatory, or administrative issues; evaluates alternatives, and makes recommendations,
* Conducts special research projects and financial analysis for countywide programs and usage; produces findings and recommendations and prepares related reports.
* Represents assigned department in interdepartmental, community and/or professional meetings; confers with and coordinates with other County staff on a wide variety of administrative analyses and planning issues.
* Serves as a liaison to public and private organizations, community groups, and other organizations; provides information and assistance to the public regarding the assigned programs and services; receives and responds to complaints, requests and questions relating to assigned area of responsibility.
* Prepares and submits Board of Supervisor agenda reports and various other commission, committee, and staff reports, resolutions, ordinances, and correspondence regarding assigned activities.
* Communicates orally, in writing, or through graphic representations and statistical summaries with colleagues, managers, employees, the public, organized employee groups and representatives of various organizations.
* May participate in the selecting, training, motivating, and evaluating assigned staff; directs the work activities of assigned staff; prioritizes and coordinates work assignments; provides or coordinates staff training; reviews work for accuracy; works with employees to correct deficiencies.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

The **ideal candidate** will possess the following:

* Working knowledge of social and economic issues relevant to low-income populations and communities, especially homelessness prevention, financial assistance programs, and/or case management.
* A commitment to improving the lives of vulnerable individuals and families and supporting the community.
* Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, oral and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Cultural competence in working with diverse communities.
* Ability to develop procedures and methods to ensure consistent compliance across diverse settings and staff.
* Experience in grant admin

jobs.description:
**Why LeoLabs?**

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Buyer, Google &Meta
jobs.description:
**About Mancini's Sleepworld**
------------------------------

Mancini's Sleepworld is Northern California's hometown mattress retailer, with 52+ showrooms across the Bay Area, Sacramento, and the Central Valley. We're family-rooted, locally known, and growing, most recently welcoming Christian's Mattress Xpress and its nine showrooms to the family. Our marketing team runs everything from broadcast and outdoor to search, social, and in-store promotions, and we're building more of that capability in-house.

**The role**
------------

We're bringing ***Google and Meta paid media in-house***, and this is the person who will run it. You'll personally build, launch, optimize, and report on a multimillion-dollar annual Google and Meta budget for Mancini's Sleepworld and Christian's Mattress Xpress, one of California's largest mattress retail groups, tying every dollar to showroom traffic and sales, not just clicks.

**This is a hands-on-the-keyboard role.** You'll be inside Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager every day, doing the work yourself. There is no agency or team underneath you; you are the operator. You'll own day-to-day execution of the budget and report results to the Digital Marketing Manager.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Campaign management (Google & Meta)

* Own day-to-day management of Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, Local/store-visit campaigns) and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, Advantage+).
* Build and maintain account structures, audiences, bidding strategies, and budgets across Mancini's 52+ store markets and the Christian's Mattress Xpress accounts.
* Launch promotional and holiday-event campaigns on tight timelines, aligned with the retail promo calendar.
* Manage Google Merchant Center product feeds and Shopping/PMAX campaigns with the e-commerce team.
* Plan and run co-op campaigns with mattress and bedding vendors on Google and Meta, following each brand's guidelines for creative, approvals, and proof-of-performance reporting.
* Expand into new platforms as they're added, such as Microsoft Ads (Bing), TikTok, and other social channels.

Optimization & testing

* Optimize daily toward ROAS, cost per lead, store visits, and sales.
* Run a structured test-and-learn program: creative, audiences, landing pages, and bidding.
* Partner with our in-house creative team and supporting creative agency: brief new ads, request platform-specific sizes and variations, and use performance data to guide what gets made next.

Measurement & reporting

* Maintain conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, offline/in-store conversion uploads.
* Connect digital spend to showroom traffic and sales; partner on attribution and incrementality testing.
* Deliver weekly performance reports and monthly insights to the Digital Marketing Manager.

Partnerships & budget

* Keep account access, documentation, and naming conventions organized so history and assets are easy to find.
* Track spend against budget and pacing, including vendor co-op funds and the documentation needed for reimbursement.
* Work directly with Google and Meta account reps.

**Qualifications**

Required

* 5–7 years of hands-on paid media experience, building and optimizing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns yourself, not only managing agencies.
* Hands-on management of $3M+ in annual Google and Meta spend, with a track record of improving ROAS and cost per acquisition.
* Advanced Google Ads: Search, Performance Max, Shopping/Merchant Center, YouTube, and local/store-visit campaigns.
* Advanced Meta Ads Manager: Advantage+, audience building, creative testing, and catalog/dynamic ads.
* Can set up and troubleshoot tracking yourself: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, UTMs.
* Strong in Excel/Google Sheets; able to build reports and explain results to non-marketers in plain language.
* Working knowledge of Looker Studio and Power BI, plus marketing tools such as Sprout Social and Funnel.io.
* Organized enough to run many campaigns, promotions, and deadlines at once without dropping details.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.

Preferred

* Multi-location retail or brick-and-mortar experience, especially driving store visits and offline sales.
* Experience with offline conversion imports, store-visit measurement, or incrementality tests.
* Agency background plus some time in-house.
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, or other emerging social platforms.
* Exposure to home furnishings, mattress, or big-ticket retail, including vendor co-op advertising programs.
* Comfort with AI-assisted creative and bidding tools.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

**Timeframe**

**What success looks like**

First 30 days

Full access to all Google and Meta accounts; tracking audited; campaigns running with no lapse in spend or performance.

60 days

Accounts restructured where needed; weekly reporting live; first test-and-learn round launched.

90 days

Performance at or above current baseline on ROAS and cost per lead; campaign plan for next quarter's promo calendar, built with the Digital Marketing Manager.

**Ongoing KPIs:** ROAS, cost per lead, store visits, online and in-store attributed sales, budget pacing, and test velocity.

**Work Environment**

In office at our Livermore corporate office Monday through Thursday; remote on Fridays. Occasional travel to our showrooms as needed.

  
Monday through Thursday - In-person at our Livermore Corporate Office.
  
Friday - Remote.
  
(Occasional travel to our showrooms as needed)

jobs.title: Financial Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
**Financial Planning Analyst**

The Financial Planning Analyst plays a key role in supporting the organization’s financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and reporting processes. This position partners with leaders across the business to provide financial insights, analyze performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable translating complex financial data into meaningful business insights. They will leverage financial systems (Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Paycor), data analytics, and emerging AI tools to improve reporting efficiency, enhance forecasting capabilities, and drive continuous improvement across finance processes.

**About Koniag Tech**

Koniag Tech is a professional services and technology company with managed services, value-added reseller, cybersecurity and consulting practices, reported through three entities. We are growing through acquisition, including international entities, and finance is scaling with us. The finance team is small and hands-on, so this role carries real ownership of the numbers leadership uses each week.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the development and execution of annual budgets, financial forecasts, and long-range financial plans, including a rolling forecast built from contracted backlog, weighted pipeline and recurring revenue.
* Analyze financial results, identify trends and variances, and provide actionable insights to leadership, with monthly variance commentary by entity and operating group against budget, reforecast and prior year.
* Prepare recurring financial reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate business performance, including the weekly revenue scorecard and monthly financial packages, tied to the general ledger.
* Partner with department leaders to understand financial performance, monitor expenses, and support financial decision-making.
* Conduct variance analysis, profitability analysis, and financial modeling to evaluate business performance and opportunities, including customer and practice profitability, billable utilization, and contractor cost versus hours.
* Analyze pipeline and backlog in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, including stage and probability assumptions, close-date slippage, revenue timing and data-quality gaps.
* Assist with month-end and quarter-end reporting, including financial reconciliations and analysis, such as reconciling revenue (invoices, non-revenue invoices and journal entries) to the GL.
* Support payroll and labor-cost reporting from Paycor, including headcount and variable compensation analysis.
* Develop and maintain financial models, forecasts, and reporting tools to improve visibility into business performance, including scenario models (for example, core business versus acquisitions).
* Support integration of acquired companies including post-close budgeting, KPIs and analysis.
* Identify opportunities to streamline financial processes, automate reporting, and improve data accuracy.
* Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and overall finance team efficiency.
* Document models, definitions and data lineage so reporting does not depend on one person.
* Support ad hoc financial analysis and special projects as needed.
* 25%+ travel required to company locations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related analytical role, ideally in professional services, IT services or technology.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, including revenue recognition and accruals.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis (XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, dynamic arrays, PivotTables, Power Query) and the ability to build clean, auditable multi-tab models.
* Experience with financial reporting tools, ERP systems (Sage Intacct, NetSuite or similar), and/or business intelligence platforms, and comfort pulling and reconciling data directly from the GL.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings effectively, including explaining variances to non-finance leaders in plain terms.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities, with a habit of tying out totals before sharing results.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with stakeholders across various departments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leveraging AI tools within finance, accounting, or financial analysis strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-powered financial modeling, forecasting, reporting automation, or data analysis tools.
* Hands-on experience with Sage Intacct, including multi-entity reporting and dimensions (location, department, customer).
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or a comparable CRM, particularly pipeline, opportunity and forecast data.
* Familiarity with Paycor or another HRIS/payroll platform, and with time-and-billing or professional services automation data.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization platforms.
* Experience with financial planning software or ERP platforms.
* Exposure to process automation (Power Query, VBA, Python, SQL), data analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with recurring-revenue businesses (managed services, subscriptions, resale), contractor cost management, or M&A analysis and integration.
* CPA, CMA or MBA, or progress toward one.

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
The 20 LLC is a nationwide Managed Service Provider (MSP) and growth platform that helps businesses and IT service companies deliver secure, scalable technology solutions.

The Risk & Compliance Analyst supports client compliance engagements from initial assessment through ongoing program management. Working across frameworks such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and CJIS, this role helps clients translate regulatory requirements into practical security controls, manage remediation efforts, and prepare for audits and third-party assessments.

This position combines compliance consulting, project management, and risk analysis, partnering with client stakeholders, internal technical teams, and external assessors to build and maintain effective compliance programs.

***This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain access to client environments subject to ITAR, CUI, CJIS, and other regulatory requirements.***

**Key Responsibilities:**

Lead Client Compliance Engagements

* Define engagement scope and assessment boundaries.
* Identify regulated data, systems, and business processes.
* Establish project plans and compliance roadmaps.
* Serve as the primary compliance contact for assigned clients.

Assess Compliance Posture

* Conduct gap assessments against applicable security, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
* Perform risk assessments and support SPRS score calculations.
* Document findings and provide actionable recommendations.

Develop and Maintain Compliance Artifacts

* Create and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), POA&Ms, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Build audit-ready evidence packages and responsibility matrices.
* Ensure documentation remains current and aligned with client environments.

Coordinate Remediation Activities

* Develop remediation plans, coordinate implementation efforts with technical teams, and validate control effectiveness.
* Track remediation progress and communicate status to stakeholders.

Prepare for Assessments and Audits

* Organize assessment evidence and documentation.
* Conduct readiness reviews and mock assessments.
* Coordinate directly with auditors, assessors, and client stakeholders.

Support Ongoing Compliance

* Manage recurring compliance activities, including evidence collection, access reviews, policy maintenance, training, and annual assessments.
* Identify compliance implications of environmental or business changes and recommend appropriate actions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Ability to obtain and maintain access to client environments subject to ITAR, CUI, CJIS, and other regulatory requirements.
* 2-4 years of experience in systems administration, networking, cybersecurity, MSP operations, technical support, or compliance-related roles.
* Experience participating in compliance projects involving assessment readiness, audit support, or ongoing compliance management.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to create professional compliance documentation.
* Ability to explain technical and compliance concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management, networking, logging, identity management, and backup technologies.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements in a fast-paced consulting environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting compliance programs aligned with CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, CJIS, ISO 27001, or HITRUST.
* Experience supporting third-party audits, assessments, or certification efforts.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 GCC/GCC High, Microsoft Defender, Intune, Purview, and related security technologies.
* Experience using compliance, governance, or GRC platforms.
* Hands-on experience implementing CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, or other security hardening standards.
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGRC, CCP, CCA, Security+, CySA+, AZ-500, SC-300, AZ-104, MD-102, RHCSA, CCNA, or equivalent credentials.

**Benefits:**

* Annual Salary Range: $60,000 - $95,000
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, supplemental coverage, plus HSA/FSA options
* Competitive 401(k) participation with up to 4% contribution match
* Certification reimbursement to support your continued development
* Meaningful opportunities for advancement within a growing organization
* A culture built on drive, accountability, collaboration, and excellence

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands below describe the essential job functions needed to complete this job.

* Consistent hand and finger dexterity necessary to operate computer equipment
* Consistently required to sit, stand, walk, talk, hear, and see
* Routine use of hands to type
* Occasional need to stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, crawl, reach, and stretch
* Consistent vision abilities required; close vision, depth perception, and ability to focus
* May require travel dependent on company needs.

They are not intended to be interpreted as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of the individual(s) holding this position.

jobs.description:
**Date:** Nov 16, 2026

**Location:** USA - Remote, US

**Company:** Bausch+Lomb Companies Inc.

Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

  

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

**Overview**

The **Senior Contracts Analyst** is a remote-based position reporting to the Vice President, Diversified Products. This role independently manages customer contracts, pricing programs, and related commercial activities for our Generic Rx Team while partnering with Commercial, Finance, National Accounts, and other cross-functional teams.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Generic Rx Commercial Marketing and National Account Directors on pricing requests, including new pricing, price reductions, and one-time buys, ensuring required approvals before customer submission.

* Manage pricing and contract routing through internal systems and wholesalers.

* Validate rebates, customer claims, failure-to-supply provisions, price protection, and shelf-stock adjustments.
* Review and interpret contract and pricing terms, research and resolve pricing discrepancies, and ensure accuracy and compliance with approved business terms.
* Manage customer surveys and ad hoc requests and identify opportunities to improve contract and pricing processes.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 5+ years of experience in contracts, pricing, commercial operations, or a related area.
* Pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience preferred.
* Experience with contract review, administration, and interpretation; contract drafting experience preferred.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical distribution channels, including wholesale, retail, and GPO, preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently resolve complex contract and pricing issues.
* Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with contract management, pricing, or ERP systems preferred.
  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

They may also be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, a tuition reimbursement program (select degrees), company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others.
